'''Jason Robinette''' was the [[Players Committee]] [[Marketing Advocate]] from 2002 to 2008.<ref name="home2002" /><ref name="council2002" /> He was also a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 3 from New York City, NY. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. He co-wrote [[Mirror, Mirror (InQuest)|Mirror, Mirror]] with [[Michael Mikaelian]] and wrote [[Jabba's Palace (InQuest)]] in ''[[InQuest]]'' #39 (July 1998).<ref name="wook-39">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/InQuest_39 InQuest 39], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20251112204442/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/InQuest_39 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="wp-swccg">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Star Wars Customizable Card Game], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016121021/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Internet Archive]</ref>

Shadow Squadron rosters of 23 April 2003, 4 June 2004, and 3 December 2005 list him as Shadow 3 (XO) in New York City.<ref name="ss-vol2003">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030423194826/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 23 April 2003)</ref><ref name="ss-vol2004">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040604020531/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 4 June 2004)</ref><ref name="ss-vol2005">[https://web.archive.org/web/20051203064943/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 December 2005)</ref>

As Marketing Advocate he posted news on the Players Committee website: the [[Young Jedi]] virtual cards on 22 November 2002, tournament legal from 30 November 2002;<ref name="pc-nov02">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/november02archives.htm November Updates], swccgpc.com (22 November 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030423221953/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/november02archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> a review of Card Vault on 6 December 2002;<ref name="pc-dec02">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/december02archives.htm December Updates], swccgpc.com (6 December 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030423221911/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/december02archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth|Virtual Card Set #4]] on 28 January 2003, tournament legal from 5 February 2003, and the rules update dated 27 January 2003 the next day;<ref name="pc-jan03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/january03archives.htm January Updates], swccgpc.com (28–29 January 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030612020737/http://swccgpc.com:80/Archives/january03archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> and a virtual card update on 4 February 2003, which marked significantly changed cards and updated Virtual Sets 2 and 3 to use the new icons.<ref name="pc-feb03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/february03archives.htm February Updates], swccgpc.com (4 February 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030423221707/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/february03archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> In a 2008 interview [[Scott Lingrell]] said that Robinette had originally designed the Players Committee's logo, its virtual card PDFs and its website from scratch.<ref name="pc-news7">[http://www.swccgpc.com/news/news.php?id=7 10 Questions with Scott Lingrell], swccgpc.com (8 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081009225918/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php?id=7 Internet Archive]</ref>

In September 2008, posting as JasonRed3, he wrote that he remembered playtesting Decipher cards and that he had stopped actively playing a few years earlier but was starting again. According to his forum signature at the time, he was a "Game Designer, Conan CCG", and his former roles, among them PC Advocate, Squadron Leader Red 3, Ambassador to Romulus and Rider of Rohan, were "All Retired".<ref name="pcf-22965-333849">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=333849#333849 Making Some Waves], Jason Robinette (JasonRed3), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080918212504/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=334263&sid=56092e540f0833f38b0175a252d0eaba Internet Archive]</ref>
